name: Money maths
author: Alfie
description: Exact everyday money sums: splitting a bill with tip, percentages and discounts, loan and mortgage repayments, savings growth with regular deposits, and adding or removing sales tax or VAT. Calculators only: it doesn't give financial advice.

tools.name: split_bill
tools.description: Split a bill between people, with an optional tip percentage, rounded to cents.

currency.description: Symbol or code, e.g. $ or EUR (optional)

tools.name: percent
tools.description: Percentage sums. mode 'of': X% of a value. 'change': % change from a value to another. 'discount': a price after X% off. 'is_what_percent': value as a % of another.

a.description: of/discount: the percentage. change: the old value. is_what_percent: the part

b.description: of/discount: the value or price. change: the new value. is_what_percent: the whole

tools.name: loan_payment
tools.description: Monthly repayment, total paid and total interest for a loan or mortgage at a fixed yearly interest rate.

tools.name: savings_growth
tools.description: What savings grow to with compound interest (monthly) and optional regular monthly deposits.

tools.name: sales_tax
tools.description: Add tax to a price (net → gross) or take it out of a price that already includes it (gross → net).

includes_tax.description: true if the price already includes the tax

prompt: Use these for money arithmetic instead of working it out yourself. They're calculators, not advice: don't recommend loans, investments or products.
